# Table

Styled semantic table parts for headers, body rows, cells, footers and captions. The wrapper supports horizontal overflow and keyboard scrolling; sorting, selection and data loading remain host responsibilities.

- **Import:** `import { Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/data-display-table--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCaption,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function TableExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Table>
        <TableCaption>A list of your recent invoices.</TableCaption>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead className="w-24">Invoice</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Method</TableHead>
            <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          <TableRow>
            <TableCell className="font-medium">INV001</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Paid</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Credit Card</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right">$250.00</TableCell>
          </TableRow>
          <TableRow>
            <TableCell className="font-medium">INV002</TableCell>
            <TableCell>Pending</TableCell>
            <TableCell>PayPal</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right">$80.00</TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Table

It forwards its ref to `HTMLTableElement`. Its props are `TableProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLTableElement>`.

- `framed`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  A 1px border round the table and the control radius, 16, at its corners
  (decision 159), as Figma, SwiftUI and Compose draw it. The header and the
  rows are clipped inside it, so a row's hover and selected fills keep its
  corners, and a caption sits inside the frame, at its foot. Off by
  default: a dense page's table runs edge to edge.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## TableHeader

It forwards its ref to `HTMLTableSectionElement`. Its props are `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLTableSectionElement>`.

## TableRow

It forwards its ref to `HTMLTableRowElement`. Its props are `TableRowProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLTableRowElement>`.

- `highlight`: `TableRowHighlight`, optional.

  `"new"` tints a row just added in the informative surface
  (`--semantics-emotion-informative-surface`) so the eye finds it, then
  fades it (GAP-276): held three deliberate durations, faded over one
  (`--semantics-motion-duration-deliberate`, 1.84 s in all). Under reduced
  motion, the system's or the design config's, the tint shows and clears
  at the same time with no fade. It plays once, when the row is drawn
  with it or is given it; give it again, after taking it away, to play it
  again.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### TableRowHighlight

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
/**
 * A row's passing highlight (GAP-276): `"new"`, a row just added, drawn on
 * the informative surface that holds, then fades.
 */
type TableRowHighlight = "new";
```
